name: Tempester n°25: 4 Pole and AD Mode LEDs follow an NRPN change
explanation: Bug (1.6.0.0): an NRPN 40 (4 Pole) or 57 (AD Mode) from the app changed the sound byte and the voices, but the Panel LED of the key kept its old state, so the machine looked unchanged (the app click worked only from the machine to the app). The physical keys call [routine](beat, pad, p, +-1) and then light the LED themselves (4 Pole: [routine](0x10 on / 0x11 off, 0x0D); AD Mode: the screen refresh [routine] -> [routine] lights LED 2 when parameter 57 = 0). NRPN reception (n°9a) calls the same [routine] and nothing more. Every other on/off or enumerated parameter (Key Follow, Wave Reset, Sync, Glide Mode, Osc Slop, Reverse, Key Assign, LFO Shape/Sync, Restart, Sample/Noise) is edited on the unit only through [routine] and has no LED: nothing differs for them but the LCD. Now knob_edit has a hook after its voice send ([address]-[address], reached only when the value changed): when the anti-echo byte [address] is 1 (the change comes from n°9a) and the parameter is 40 or 57, and [routine]() is false (not 16 Beats / 16 Mutes, where the key is refused and the LED stays off), it reads the byte of the SELECTED pad ([address], [address]: the LED shows that pad, n°9a may have edited another one) and sends [routine](0x10 lit / 0x11 off, LED 0x0D for 4 Pole lit when not 0, LED 0x02 for AD Mode lit when 0), as the key handlers. Panel edits ([address] = 0) and every other parameter take the original path unchanged. The LCD is still not redrawn. Requires nrpn_reception (n°9a). 2 words in place, 33 words at 0x9D07CA00.

edits.why: j 0x9d07ca00 ; knob_edit: was "li v0,0x2e" (parameter 0x2e: tail call to [routine]). The delay slot below replaces the "bne".
li v0,0x2e ; delay slot of the j above: was "bne s2,v0,[address]". The test is redone at the end of LEDFIX; the "move a0,s1" at [address] stays the delay slot of that second test.
lbu t0,-0x7f78(gp) ; [address] = 1: the change comes from MIDI (n°9a). Panel and other edits: nothing to do (their own handler lights the LED)
addiu t1,s2,-0x39 ; delay slot: parameter 57 (AD Mode)?
jal [address] ; [routine]: true in 16 Beats / 16 Mutes, where these LEDs are never lit
lw a0,-0x7a2c(gp) ; delay slot: a0 = UI beat [address]
sltu t1,zero,v0 ; delay slot: 4 Pole LED lit when the value is not 0
sltiu t1,v0,0x1 ; AD Mode LED lit when parameter 57 = 0
jal [address] ; [routine](0x10 - lit, LED), as the key handlers
subu a0,a0,t1 ; delay slot: 0x11 off, 0x10 on
li v0,0x2e ; the replaced test of knob_edit: parameter 0x2e goes on to [routine]
beq s2,v0,0x9d07ca74 ; (the original "bne" to [address] is out of branch range from here: inverted test + j)
or a0,s1,zero ; delay slot: a0 = beat (original "move a0,s1" of [address])
j [address] ; other parameters: return as before
j [address] ; parameter 0x2e: restore the registers and tail-call [routine](beat)
